sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emily. Today I will talk about a very
famous city in Italy. The city is called Milan. Milan is a very important city. It is in the
north of Italy. About 1.4 million people live in Milan. Many people visit Milan every year.
They come for fashion, art, food, and history. Milan is very famous for fashion. Many big fashion
companies are here. There are many fashion shops and stores. Every year Milan has a fashion week.
Many models, designers, and people from all over the world come to Milan. They show new clothes and
styles. Milan is one of the fashion capitals of the world. Milan is also famous for art and history.
There are many old buildings and beautiful places. One very famous place is the Duomo di Milano.
The Duomo is a big cathedral or church. It is very old and very big. The church has many statues
and beautiful details. You can go on the roof of the Duomo. From there you can see the city.
Near the Duomo is the Galleria Vittorio Emmanuel of the Second. It is a very old and beautiful shopping
center. The building has big glass ceilings and many shops. People go there to walk, shop, and eat.
There are cafes and restaurants. It is a nice place to visit. Milan also has a famous opera
house called La Scala. La Scala is one of the best theaters in the world. People come from many
countries to watch opera and concerts. It is a very special place for music and culture.
If you like art, you can visit the church Santa Maria Delegrazier. There you can see the famous
painting The Last Supper by Leonardo da Vinci. This painting is very old and very important.
Many people want to see this artwork. Milan is also an important city for business and money.
Many big companies have offices in Milan. People work in banks, stores, and companies.
Milan is a busy city with many workers and visitors. The food in Milan is very tasty.
You can try risotto ala Milanese. It is a rice dish made with saffron. It is yellow and delicious.
Another popular dish is clodletta ala Milanese. It is breaded meat like a fried cutlet. For dessert, Milan has
Panatone. Panatone is a sweet bread with fruits. People eat it, especially at Christmas. Milan has
good transportation. You can take buses, trams, and the metro. The metro is fast and easy.
It helps people go around the city quickly. The weather in Milan changes with the seasons.
In summer, it is warm and sunny. In winter, it can be cold and sometimes it snows. Spring and autumn
are nice and cool. Milan is a city of culture, fashion, art, and business. Many people love this city.
It is a city with old history and new ideas. If you visit Milan, you can see beautiful buildings,
eat good food, and shop in famous stores. You can learn about history and enjoy music and art.
